function ropeGestureTarget(direction){

function ropeGestureTargetValid(direction,a){

 if(!rope.attached||ropeChainRemaining<=0||ropePointerAim?.gesture!=='transfer')return false;

function ropeGestureFeedback(){

 b.classList.toggle('aiming',!!g);
 b.classList.remove('aim-good','aim-bad');h.className='';
 if(!g){h.textContent='';return;}
 let label='',quality='';
 if(g.wasActive){
  if(g.gesture==='reel')label=g.lastY<g.y?'↑ 줄 감기':'↓ 줄 풀기';
  else if(g.gesture==='transfer'){
   const good=ropeGestureTargetValid(g.direction,ropePreviewAnchor);
   label=(ROPE_AIM_SYMBOLS[g.direction]||'↗')+(good?' 갈아타기':' 연결 불가');quality=good?'good':'bad';
  }else label='탭: 해제 · 드래그: 연결점 변경';
 }else{

}
function ropeDirectionFromGesture(dx,dy,previous='up'){
 if(Math.abs(dx)<ROPE_TOUCH_SLOP){
  if(previous!=='up'&&Math.abs(dx)>=ROPE_TOUCH_SLOP-ROPE_AIM_AXIS_HYST)return previous;
  return 'up';
 }
 const side=dx<0?'left':'right';
 if(previous!=='up'&&previous.endsWith('left')!==side.endsWith('left')&&Math.abs(dx)<ROPE_TOUCH_SLOP+ROPE_AIM_AXIS_HYST)return previous;
 const prevHigh=previous.startsWith('up')&&previous!=='up';
 const bias=previous==='up'?0:(prevHigh?ROPE_AIM_AXIS_HYST:-ROPE_AIM_AXIS_HYST);
 const wantUp=dy<-Math.max(11,Math.abs(dx)*.38)+bias;
 return (wantUp?'up':'')+side;
}

// Mouse world coordinates are derived from the same camera transform as mining.
// The shipped anchor system currently supports five directions, not downward or arbitrary-angle ropes.
function desktopRopeDirection(clientX,clientY){
 const r=cv.getBoundingClientRect();
 const wx=(clientX-r.left+camera.x)/T,wy=(clientY-r.top+camera.y)/T;
 const dx=wx-p.x,dy=wy-(p.y-PLAYER_CENTER_FROM_FEET);
 if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<.28)return 'up';
 if(dy>Math.abs(dx)*.5)return null; // no downward grappling in the current engine
 if(dy<-Math.abs(dx)*1.5)return 'up';
 if(dy<-Math.abs(dx)*.45)return dx<0?'upleft':'upright';
 return dx<0?'left':'right';
}
function desktopRightClickRope(e){
 if(e.button!==2||paused||ssIsTitle())return false;
 ropeABRightClicks++;
 const direction=desktopRopeDirection(e.clientX,e.clientY);
 if(!direction){flash('아래쪽 로프는 아직 지원하지 않아요. 위쪽·좌우 암벽을 조준해 주세요.');return false;}
 if(rope.active){
  if(e.shiftKey&&rope.attached)return transferRope(direction);
  toggleRope();return !rope.active;
 }
 ropeABFireAttempts++;
 return fireDirectionalRope(direction);
}


// SANDSTAR 2.18-D: Character traits and collectible/equippable artifacts.
// Legacy game.relics remains the integer counting mined relic tiles.
const TRAIT_INFO=Object.freeze({
 pioneer:{name:'개척자',icon:'⛏',tag:'채굴 +3% · 신규 깊이 경험치 +10%'},

});
const ARTIFACT_INFO=Object.freeze({
 luminous_fossil:{name:'야광 화석',icon:'✦',tag:'지하 시야 +2칸',how:'18m 깊이에 처음 도달'},
 wind_compass:{name:'바람 나침반',icon:'➳',tag:'이동속도 +0.35칸/초',how:'누적 이동거리 100칸'},
 spring_horseshoe:{name:'용수철 편자',icon:'⇧',tag:'일반 점프 상승력 +0.6',how:'자연 블록 50개 채굴'},
 old_pulley:{name:'낡은 도르래',icon:'⌘',tag:'로프 상승속도 +20%',how:'로프 상승 첫 성공'},
 knot_ring:{name:'매듭의 고리',icon:'◎',tag:'로프 도약 사용권 +1',how:'광부 Lv.10 달성'},
 crystal_lens:{name:'수정 렌즈',icon:'◇',tag:'시야 안 광석 윤곽 강조',how:'수정 블록 첫 채굴'}
});
const TRAIT_IDS=Object.keys(TRAIT_INFO),ARTIFACT_IDS=Object.keys(ARTIFACT_INFO);
const ARTIFACT_REWARDS=[
 ['depth_18_first','luminous_fossil', a=>a.character.claimedMilestones.includes('depth_18')],
 ['first_travel_100_tiles','wind_compass', a=>a.artifactSystem.progress.distanceTiles>=100],
 ['first_50_natural_blocks','spring_horseshoe',a=>a.artifactSystem.progress.naturalBlocks>=50],
 ['first_rope_ascent_success','old_pulley',a=>a.artifactSystem.progress.ropeAscents>=1],
 ['reach_character_level_10','knot_ring',a=>deriveLevelFromTotalXp(a.character.totalXp).level>=10],
 ['first_crystal_mine','crystal_lens',a=>a.artifactSystem.progress.crystalsMined>=1]
];
function freshArtifactSystem(){return {schemaVersion:1,ownedIds:[],equippedIds:[],claimedRewardIds:[],progress:{distanceTiles:0,naturalBlocks:0,ropeAscents:0,crystalsMined:0}};}
function normalizeArtifactSystem(raw,level){
 const v=raw&&typeof raw==='object'&&!Array.isArray(raw)?raw:{};
 const out=freshArtifactSystem();
 const valid=arr=>Array.isArray(arr)?[...new Set(arr.filter(id=>typeof id==='string'&&ARTIFACT_IDS.includes(id)))]:[];
 out.ownedIds=valid(v.ownedIds);
 out.claimedRewardIds=valid(v.claimedRewardIds); // canonical claims are unique artifact IDs
 for(const id of out.claimedRewardIds)if(!out.ownedIds.includes(id))out.ownedIds.push(id);
 for(const id of out.ownedIds)if(!out.claimedRewardIds.includes(id))out.claimedRewardIds.push(id);
 const allowed=(level>=12?2:1);
 out.equippedIds=valid(v.equippedIds).filter(id=>out.ownedIds.includes(id)).slice(0,allowed);
 const pr=v.progress&&typeof v.progress==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v.progress)?v.progress:{};
 for(const k of Object.keys(out.progress)){
  const n=Number(pr[k]);out.progress[k]=Number.isFinite(n)&&n>=0?Math.min(1e9,n):0;
 }
 return out;
}
function artifactEquipped(id){return Array.isArray(game?.artifactSystem?.equippedIds)&&game.artifactSystem.equippedIds.includes(id);}
function artifactSlotsFor(level=deriveLevelFromTotalXp(game.character.totalXp).level){return level>=12?2:1;}
function tryAwardEarnedArtifacts(){
 if(!game?.artifactSystem||!game?.character)return false;
 const pending=ARTIFACT_REWARDS.filter(([rid,id,earned])=>!game.artifactSystem.claimedRewardIds.includes(id)&&earned(game));
 if(!pending.length)return false;
 const ok=safeCharacterTransaction(draft=>{
  const sys=draft.artifactSystem;
  for(const [rid,id] of pending){
   if(!sys.ownedIds.includes(id))sys.ownedIds.push(id);
   if(!sys.claimedRewardIds.includes(id))sys.claimedRewardIds.push(id);
  }
  return true;
 });
 if(ok){flash(`유물 획득! ${pending.map(x=>ARTIFACT_INFO[x[1]].name).join(' · ')}`);return true;}
 return false;
}
function selectCharacterTrait(id){
 if(!TRAIT_IDS.includes(id)||game.character.trait===id)return false;
 const ok=safeCharacterTransaction(draft=>{
  const c=draft.character;
  if(c.trait!==null){
   if(deriveLevelFromTotalXp(c.totalXp).level<10)return false;
   if(c.traitFreeChangeUsed){if(draft.coins<200)return false;draft.coins-=200;}
   else c.traitFreeChangeUsed=true;
  }
  c.trait=id;return true;
 });
 if(ok){visionCache.cx=-999;updateMobilityHud();}
 return ok;
}
function equipArtifact(slot,id){
 if(!Number.isInteger(slot)||slot<0||slot>=artifactSlotsFor())return false;
 if(id!==null&&!ARTIFACT_IDS.includes(id))return false;
 if(id!==null&&!game.artifactSystem.ownedIds.includes(id))return false;
 if(id!==null&&game.artifactSystem.equippedIds.includes(id)&&game.artifactSystem.equippedIds[slot]!==id)return false;
 const oldId=game.artifactSystem.equippedIds[slot]||null;
 if(oldId===id)return false;
 const ok=safeCharacterTransaction(draft=>{
  if(slot>=artifactSlotsFor(deriveLevelFromTotalXp(draft.character.totalXp).level))return false;
  const ids=draft.artifactSystem.equippedIds;
  if(id!==null&&ids.some((v,i)=>i!==slot&&v===id))return false;
  // Keep equip array densely populated. Slot 2 may be empty only if slot 1 occupied.
  if(slot>0&&!ids[0]&&id!==null)return false;
  if(id===null){ids.splice(slot,1);}
  else ids[slot]=id;
  return true;
 });
 if(ok){clampRopeLeaps();visionCache.cx=-999;updateMobilityHud();}
 return ok;
}
// Central passive calculation: stat allocation, trait and equipped artifact -> hard caps.
function getEffectiveStats(){
 const agility=statLevel('agility'),jump=statLevel('jump'),climb=statLevel('climb'),focus=statLevel('focus'),endurance=statLevel('endurance');
 const trait=game?.character?.trait;
 return {
  moveSpeed:Math.min(6.5,MOVE_SPEED+agility*.10+(trait==='wanderer'?.15:0)+(artifactEquipped('wind_compass')?.35:0)),
  jumpImpulse:Math.min(11.0,NORMAL_JUMP+jump*.12+(artifactEquipped('spring_horseshoe')?.6:0)),
  ropeLeapImpulse:Math.min(15.0,ROPE_LEAP+jump*.08),
  ropeClimbSpeed:Math.min(9.5,6.2*(1+climb*.04+(trait==='rope_master'?.08:0)+(artifactEquipped('old_pulley')?.2:0))),
  mineMultiplier:Math.min(1.2,1+focus*.015+(trait==='pioneer'?.03:0)),
  ropeCooldown:Math.max(.24,.36-endurance*.015),
  ropeLeapMax:Math.min(3,1+(endurance>=5?1:0)+(artifactEquipped('knot_ring')?1:0)),
  sightRadius:Math.min(8,3+Math.floor(Math.min(8,statLevel('observation'))/3)+(trait==='searcher'?1:0)+(artifactEquipped('luminous_fossil')?2:0))
 };
}
let artifactTravelCheckpoint=0,ropeAscentStartY=null;
function noteArtifactDistance(delta){
 if(!game?.artifactSystem||!Number.isFinite(delta)||delta<=0)return;
 game.artifactSystem.progress.distanceTiles=Math.min(1e9,game.artifactSystem.progress.distanceTiles+delta);
}
function noteRopeAscent(){
 if(ropeAscentStartY!==null&&p&&p.y<=ropeAscentStartY-1){
  game.artifactSystem.progress.ropeAscents++;
 }
 ropeAscentStartY=null;
}
function drawArtifactLens(){if(ssRegion==='life_forest_01')return;
 if(!artifactEquipped('crystal_lens'))return;
 const r=effectiveSightRadius(),cx=Math.floor(p.x),cy=Math.floor(p.y-PLAYER_CENTER_FROM_FEET);
 ctx.save();ctx.strokeStyle='#b1fbec';ctx.lineWidth=2;
 for(let y=Math.max(0,cy-r);y<=Math.min(WH-1,cy+r);y++)for(let x=Math.max(0,cx-r);x<=Math.min(WW-1,cx+r);x++){
  if(!visionVisible(x,y)||!ORES.has(tile(x,y)))continue;
  const sx=Math.floor(x*T-camera.x),sy=Math.floor(y*T-camera.y);
  if(sx+T<0||sy+T<0||sx>viewW||sy>viewH)continue;
  ctx.strokeRect(sx+3,sy+3,T-6,T-6);
 }
 ctx.restore();
}

// 2.4: responsive airborne steering, generous jump timing, one rope leap per landing.
// Transient motion is never saved, preserving the earlier world save contract.
const NORMAL_JUMP=9.5, ROPE_LEAP=14.1;
const MOVE_SPEED=5.2, COYOTE_WINDOW=.115, JUMP_BUFFER_WINDOW=.145;
// 2.18-B: rope jump is a conserved charge pool, not a per-airtime boolean.
// Persist remaining charges on save; rope reconnect NEVER refills them.
let ropeLeapRemaining=1,ropeGroundStableSeconds=0,ropeGrabCooldown=0,ropeSnap=null;
function statLevel(id){return Math.min(8,Math.max(0,Number(game?.character?.stats?.[id])||0));}
// Mining distance is an SP-powered character stat. Legacy saves without 'reach' use level 0.
function effectiveMineReach(){return Math.min(4.8,MAX_MINE_REACH+statLevel('reach')*.35);}
function mobilityDerived(){const stats=getEffectiveStats();if(ssP14Crafted('reinforced_rope'))stats.ropeClimbSpeed=Math.min(9.5,stats.ropeClimbSpeed*1.12);if(equippedSecondary()==='line')stats.ropeClimbSpeed=Math.min(9.5,stats.ropeClimbSpeed*(secondaryBoosted()?1.10:1.06));return stats;}
function remainingRopeLeaps(){return Math.min(mobilityDerived().ropeLeapMax,Math.max(0,ropeLeapRemaining));}
function clampRopeLeaps(){ropeLeapRemaining=remainingRopeLeaps();}
function refillRopeLeapsOnGround(dt){
 if(rope.active||!p||!collides(p.x,p.y+.055)||p.vy<0){ropeGroundStableSeconds=0;return;}
 ropeGroundStableSeconds=Math.min(.12,ropeGroundStableSeconds+dt);
 if(ropeGroundStableSeconds>=.08){
  ropeLeapRemaining=mobilityDerived().ropeLeapMax;
  ropeChainRemaining=p16RopeChainCap();ropeChainWindow=0;
 }
}

const liftDoorSprites={open:new Image(),locked:new Image(),ready:false,failed:false};
let liftLoadCount=0;

liftDoorSprites.open.onload=liftOnLoaded;
liftDoorSprites.locked.onload=liftOnLoaded;

function drawLiftDoor(station,centerX,baseY,unlocked,near){
 const x=Math.round(centerX-LIFT_SPRITE_WIDTH/2),y=Math.round(baseY-LIFT_SPRITE_HEIGHT);
 const img=unlocked?liftDoorSprites.open:liftDoorSprites.locked;
 if(img.complete&&img.naturalWidth===LIFT_SPRITE_WIDTH){
  ctx.drawImage(img,x,y,LIFT_SPRITE_WIDTH,LIFT_SPRITE_HEIGHT);
 }else{
  // Last-resort placeholder only while waiting for PNG decode; no legacy LIFT text.
  ctx.fillStyle='#233d4b';ctx.fillRect(x+13,y+16,54,91);
  ctx.strokeStyle='#dbb97e';ctx.lineWidth=4;ctx.strokeRect(x+13,y+16,54,91);

 }
 if(near){
  ctx.save();ctx.strokeStyle='#ffef9b';ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.strokeRect(x-2,y-2,LIFT_SPRITE_WIDTH+4,LIFT_SPRITE_HEIGHT+4);
  ctx.restore();
 }
}

const MARKET_X=23,SPAWN_X=28;

// SANDSTAR 2.17: original local sprite assets, embedded (offline first).
// Both buildings are owned by the independent town world, never rendered or opened from the mine.
const BUILDING_DATA=[{id:'forge',name:'작업 대장간',x:45},{id:'market',name:'바람장터',x:MARKET_X}];
const BUILDING_IMAGES={market:new Image(),forge:new Image()};
const BUILDING_SOURCES={market:'data:image/png;base64,',forge:'data:image/png;base64,'};
for(const k of ['market','forge'])BUILDING_IMAGES[k].src=BUILDING_SOURCES[k];
let marketSection='sell',forgeSection='pickaxe';
function closestBuilding(){if(ssRegion!==TOWN_WORLD_ID)return null;if(!p||!game)return null;let best=null,dist=Infinity;for(const b of BUILDING_DATA){
 const foot=terrain(b.x)-1,dx=Math.abs(p.x-b.x),dy=Math.abs(p.y-foot);
 if(dx>3.25||dy>3.6)continue;
 const d=Math.hypot(dx,dy*.75);if(d<dist){best=b;dist=d;}
}return best;}
function enterNearbyBuilding(){const b=closestBuilding();if(!b){flash('건물 입구 근처에서 이용할 수 있어요');return false;}
 if(b.id==='forge')return forgeMenu();return market();}
function canOpenBuilding(id){if(town25dActive&&ssRegion===TOWN_WORLD_ID){const t=t25Closest();return !!t&&t.id===id&&t25Distance(t)<=2.65;}const b=closestBuilding();return !!b&&b.id===id;}
function shopIcon(t){return '<span class="shop-ico" data-type="'+t+'" aria-hidden="true"></span>';}
function venueHeader(id,sub){const b=BUILDING_DATA.find(x=>x.id===id);return '<header class="venue-hero"><img alt="" src="'+BUILDING_SOURCES[id]+'"><div><h3>'+b.name+'</h3><p>'+sub+'</p></div><span class="venue-wallet">'+game.coins+' C</span><button type="button" id="venueClose" class="venue-close" aria-label="시설 메뉴 닫기">×</button></header>';}
function venueTabs(items,current){return '<nav class="venue-tabs" aria-label="시설 메뉴">'+items.map(([id,label,ico])=>'<button type="button" data-section="'+id+'" class="'+(current===id?'active':'')+'" aria-current="'+(current===id?'page':'false')+'">'+shopIcon(ico)+label+'</button>').join('')+'</nav>';}
function venuePresent(title,html){showModal(title,html);$('dialog').classList.add('venue-dialog');$('backBtn').parentNode.classList.add('venue-footer');$('venueClose').onclick=closeModal;}

const hash=(n)=>{n=Math.imul(n^(n>>>16),0x7feb352d);n=Math.imul(n^(n>>>15),0x846ca68b);return ((n^(n>>>16))>>>0)/4294967296};
function noise1(seed,x){let a=Math.floor(x),q=x-a; q=q*q*(3-2*q);return hash(a*1013+seed*71)*(1-q)+hash((a+1)*1013+seed*71)*q}
const rand=(x,y,k=0)=>hash((x*73856093)^(y*19349663)^(k*83492791)^game.seed);
let game;
function biomeAt(x){if(x<72)return 'meadow';if(x<180)return 'forest';if(x<290)return 'desert';if(x<392)return 'snow';return 'highlands'}
// Local-only game statistics added in 2.16-A. No analytics IDs, external URLs or network calls.
function freshBalanceMetrics(){return {version:1,activeSeconds:0,miningSeconds:0,movingSeconds:0,marketSeconds:0,blocksBroken:0,oreMined:0,oreBonus:0,oreByType:{},oreSold:0,creditsSold:0,forgeAttempts:0,forgeFailures:0,forgeCreditsSpent:0,affinityCreditsSpent:0,toolCreditsSpent:0,skillCreditsSpent:0};}
function normalizeBalanceMetrics(raw){
 const m=freshBalanceMetrics();if(!raw||typeof raw!=='object'||Array.isArray(raw))return m;
 const all=['activeSeconds','miningSeconds','movingSeconds','marketSeconds','blocksBroken','oreMined','oreBonus','oreSold','creditsSold','forgeAttempts','forgeFailures','forgeCreditsSpent','affinityCreditsSpent','toolCreditsSpent','skillCreditsSpent'];
 for(const k of all){const n=Number(raw[k]);if(Number.isFinite(n)&&n>=0)m[k]=Math.min(n,1e12);}
 if(raw.oreByType&&typeof raw.oreByType==='object'&&!Array.isArray(raw.oreByType)){
  for(const id of ['orecoal','copper','iron','crystal','amber','opal']){const n=Number(raw.oreByType[id]);if(Number.isSafeInteger(n)&&n>=0)m.oreByType[id]=Math.min(n,1e12);}
 }
 return m;
}
function balanceStats(state=game){return state.economy.balanceMetrics;}
function balanceMetricsMarkup(){
 const m=balanceStats(),minutes=m.activeSeconds/60, perMinute=minutes>=.25?(m.oreMined/minutes).toFixed(2):'측정 중';
 const creditRate=minutes>=.25?(m.creditsSold/minutes).toFixed(1):'측정 중';
 return `<div class="balance-stats" aria-label="로컬 경제 플레이 기록"><strong>경제 활동 기록 (2.16-A 설치 이후)</strong><br>플레이 ${(m.activeSeconds/60).toFixed(1)}분 · 채굴 조작 ${(m.miningSeconds/60).toFixed(1)}분 · 이동 ${(m.movingSeconds/60).toFixed(1)}분<br>광물 ${m.oreMined}개 · 정광 추가 ${m.oreBonus}개 · 광물 분당 ${perMinute}개<br>판매 ${m.oreSold}개 / ${m.creditsSold}C · 판매 수익 분당 ${creditRate}C<br>곡괭이 강화 ${m.forgeAttempts}회 (실패 ${m.forgeFailures}회) · 강화 현금 지출 ${m.forgeCreditsSpent}C<br><small>기존 기록과 구분되는 2.16-A 이후 집계. 분당 수치는 실제 입력을 자동 재생한 값이 아닌 이 기기 플레이 시간 기준이며, 거래·이동 시간 포함. 저장 파일에만 기록되고 외부 전송하지 않아요.</small></div>`;
}

// 2.18-A XP/SP retained; 2.18-B enables physical effects on stat allocations.
const CHARACTER_STAT_IDS=['agility','jump','climb','observation','focus','endurance','reach'];
const CHARACTER_STAT_NAMES={agility:'기동',jump:'도약',climb:'등반',observation:'관찰',focus:'집중',endurance:'지구력',reach:'채굴 사거리'};
const CHARACTER_MILESTONES=[{id:'depth_18',depth:18,xp:10},{id:'depth_45',depth:45,xp:15},{id:'depth_90',depth:90,xp:20}];
const XP_BIT_BYTES=Math.ceil(WW*WH/8), MAX_CHARACTER_XP=1000000000000;
let xpClaimBits=new Uint8Array(XP_BIT_BYTES);
function xpRequiredForNext(level){if(!Number.isSafeInteger(level)||level<1||level>=30)return 0;const k=level-1;return 60+25*k+5*k*k;}
function deriveLevelFromTotalXp(totalXp){const xp=Number.isSafeInteger(totalXp)&&totalXp>=0?totalXp:0;let level=1,spent=0;while(level<30){const required=xpRequiredForNext(level);if(xp<spent+required)break;spent+=required;level++;}return {level,earnedThisLevel:xp-spent,requiredNext:xpRequiredForNext(level),xpForLevel:spent};}

// 2.18-C: Pixel visibility and persistent exploration, independent of XP and map edits.
// The XP claim and vision bitsets each use WW*WH/8 bytes; existing world generation is unchanged.
const VISION_START_DEPTH=7, VISION_FADE_DEPTH=5;
// Future 2.18-D unlocks these bonuses only after validated trait/artifact ownership.
// 2.18-D: trait and artifact sight bonuses are verified on inventory/equip before use.
const VISION_BIT_BYTES=Math.ceil(WW*WH/8);
let visionExploredBits=new Uint8Array(VISION_BIT_BYTES),visionSolidBits=new Uint8Array(VISION_BIT_BYTES);
let visionCache={cx:-999,cy:-999,radius:-1,active:false,visible:new Set()};
function freshVision(){return {schemaVersion:1,exploredB64:'',solidB64:''};}
function normalizeVision(raw){
 const r=raw&&typeof raw==='object'&&!Array.isArray(raw)?raw:{};
 const explored=decodeXpClaims(r.exploredB64),solids=decodeXpClaims(r.solidB64);
 for(let i=0;i<solids.length;i++)solids[i]&=explored[i]; // remembered solids must have been seen.
 visionExploredBits=explored;visionSolidBits=solids;
 visionCache={cx:-999,cy:-999,radius:-1,active:false,visible:new Set()};
 return {schemaVersion:1,exploredB64:encodeXpClaims(explored),solidB64:encodeXpClaims(solids)};
}
function effectiveSightRadius(){return Math.min(8,getEffectiveStats().sightRadius+(ssP14Crafted('cave_lamp')?1:0)+(equippedSecondary()==='lantern'?(secondaryBoosted()?2:1):0));}

function visionDepth(){return Math.max(0,p.y-terrain(p.x));}
function visionFade(){return Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(visionDepth()-VISION_FADE_DEPTH)/(VISION_START_DEPTH-VISION_FADE_DEPTH)));}
function visionCellIndex(x,y){return Number.isInteger(x)&&Number.isInteger(y)&&x>=0&&x<WW&&y>=0&&y<WH?y*WW+x:-1;}
function bitRead(bits,x,y){const i=visionCellIndex(x,y);return i>=0&&(bits[i>>3]&(1<<(i&7)))!==0;}
function bitWrite(bits,x,y,yes){const i=visionCellIndex(x,y);if(i<0)return;const mask=1<<(i&7);if(yes)bits[i>>3]|=mask;else bits[i>>3]&=~mask;}
function visionVisible(x,y){
 if(visionDepth()<VISION_FADE_DEPTH)return true;
 updateVisionCache();return visionCache.visible.has(y*WW+x);
}
function isExplored(x,y){return bitRead(visionExploredBits,x,y);}
function updateVisionCache(force=false){
 if(ssRegion==='life_forest_01')return;
 if(!p||!game)return;
 const cx=Math.floor(p.x),cy=Math.floor(p.y-PLAYER_CENTER_FROM_FEET),radius=effectiveSightRadius(),active=visionDepth()>=VISION_FADE_DEPTH;
 if(!force&&cx===visionCache.cx&&cy===visionCache.cy&&radius===visionCache.radius&&active===visionCache.active)return;
 visionCache={cx,cy,radius,active,visible:new Set()};
 const r2=radius*radius;
 for(let y=cy-radius;y<=cy+radius;y++)for(let x=cx-radius;x<=cx+radius;x++){
  if(visionCellIndex(x,y)<0)continue;
  if((x-cx)**2+(y-cy)**2>r2)continue;
  visionCache.visible.add(y*WW+x);
 }
 if(!active)return;
 for(const index of visionCache.visible){
   const x=index%WW,y=Math.floor(index/WW),t=tile(x,y);
   bitWrite(visionExploredBits,x,y,true);
   bitWrite(visionSolidBits,x,y,solid(t));
 }
}
function onVisibleTileChanged(x,y,t){
 if(p&&visionDepth()>=VISION_FADE_DEPTH&&visionVisible(x,y)){
  bitWrite(visionExploredBits,x,y,true);bitWrite(visionSolidBits,x,y,solid(t));
 }
}
function prepareVisionForSave(){
 if(ssRegion==='life_forest_01')return;
 if(!game)return;
 updateVisionCache();
 game.vision={schemaVersion:1,exploredB64:encodeXpClaims(visionExploredBits),solidB64:encodeXpClaims(visionSolidBits)};
}
function drawVisibilityMask(){
 if(ssRegion==='life_forest_01')return;
 const fade=visionFade();if(fade<=0)return;
 updateVisionCache();
 const fromX=Math.floor(camera.x/T),toX=Math.ceil((camera.x+viewW)/T),fromY=Math.floor(camera.y/T),toY=Math.ceil((camera.y+viewH)/T);
 ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=fade;
 // Each hidden cell is replaced by an OPAQUE neutral tile; no resource color can bleed through.
 for(let y=fromY;y<=toY;y++)for(let x=fromX;x<=toX;x++){
  if(visionCache.visible.has(y*WW+x))continue;
  const sx=Math.floor(x*T-camera.x),sy=Math.floor(y*T-camera.y);
  ctx.fillStyle='#050d18';ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,T+1,T+1);
  if(isExplored(x,y)&&bitRead(visionSolidBits,x,y)){
   ctx.fillStyle='#243241';ctx.fillRect(sx+2,sy+2,T-3,T-3);
   ctx.fillStyle='#314454';ctx.fillRect(sx+3,sy+3,T-7,2);
  }else if(isExplored(x,y)){
   ctx.fillStyle='#101d2b';ctx.fillRect(sx+1,sy+1,T,T);
  }
 }
 ctx.restore();
}

function freshCharacter(){return {schemaVersion:1,totalXp:0,stats:Object.fromEntries(CHARACTER_STAT_IDS.map(id=>[id,0])),trait:null,traitFreeChangeUsed:false,statFreeResetUsed:false,claimedMilestones:[],xpClaimedCellsB64:'',mobility:{ropeLeapRemaining:1,wasAirborne:false}};}
function getUnspentSp(character=game.character){const level=deriveLevelFromTotalXp(character.totalXp).level;const used=CHARACTER_STAT_IDS.reduce((n,k)=>n+(character.stats[k]||0),0);return Math.max(0,level-1-used);}
function encodeXpClaims(bits=xpClaimBits){let text='';for(let i=0;i<bits.length;i+=2048)text+=String.fromCharCode(...bits.subarray(i,i+2048));return btoa(text);}
function decodeXpClaims(value){if(typeof value!=='string'||!value)return new Uint8Array(XP_BIT_BYTES);if(value.length!==Math.ceil(XP_BIT_BYTES/3)*4||!/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$/.test(value))return new Uint8Array(XP_BIT_BYTES);try{const raw=atob(value);if(raw.length!==XP_BIT_BYTES)return new Uint8Array(XP_BIT_BYTES);const out=new Uint8Array(XP_BIT_BYTES);for(let i=0;i<raw.length;i++)out[i]=raw.charCodeAt(i);return out;}catch(_){return new Uint8Array(XP_BIT_BYTES);}}
function xpCellIndex(x,y){return Number.isInteger(x)&&Number.isInteger(y)&&x>=0&&x<WW&&y>=0&&y<WH?y*WW+x:-1;}
function xpCellClaimed(x,y){const pos=xpCellIndex(x,y);return pos<0?true:!!(xpClaimBits[pos>>3]&(1<<(pos&7)));}
function claimXpCell(x,y){const pos=xpCellIndex(x,y);if(pos<0)return false;const bit=1<<(pos&7);if(xpClaimBits[pos>>3]&bit)return false;xpClaimBits[pos>>3]|=bit;return true;}
function markOldRemovedCells(bits,edits){for(const [loc,tileValue] of Object.entries(edits||{})){if(tileValue!==null)continue;const match=/^(\d+),(\d+)$/.exec(loc);if(!match)continue;const x=+match[1],y=+match[2],pos=xpCellIndex(x,y);if(pos>=0)bits[pos>>3]|=1<<(pos&7);}}
function normalizeCharacter(raw,edits){
 const legacy=!raw||typeof raw!=='object'||Array.isArray(raw);
 const current=legacy?{}:raw;
 const c=freshCharacter();
 if(Number.isSafeInteger(current.totalXp)&&current.totalXp>=0)c.totalXp=Math.min(MAX_CHARACTER_XP,current.totalXp);
 if(current.stats&&typeof current.stats==='object'&&!Array.isArray(current.stats))for(const name of CHARACTER_STAT_IDS){const n=current.stats[name];c.stats[name]=Number.isSafeInteger(n)?Math.min(8,Math.max(0,n)):0;}
 // Never mint extra SP by accepting a saved stat total above level allowance.
 let over=CHARACTER_STAT_IDS.reduce((a,k)=>a+c.stats[k],0)-(deriveLevelFromTotalXp(c.totalXp).level-1);
 for(const name of [...CHARACTER_STAT_IDS].reverse()){if(over<=0)break;const trim=Math.min(over,c.stats[name]);c.stats[name]-=trim;over-=trim;}
 // Validate persisted remaining rope charges, including exhausted at an airborne save.
 const incomingMobility=current.mobility&&typeof current.mobility==='object'&&!Array.isArray(current.mobility)?current.mobility:{};
 // 2.18-E: Keep raw saved charge count up to the absolute 3-charge limit.
  // Knot ring ownership/equipment is validated later by normalizeArtifactSystem().
  // The final, trusted per-player cap is applied in normalizeSave() and spawnPlayer().
  const maxCharges=3;
 c.mobility={ropeLeapRemaining:Number.isSafeInteger(incomingMobility.ropeLeapRemaining)?Math.max(0,Math.min(maxCharges,incomingMobility.ropeLeapRemaining)):maxCharges,wasAirborne:incomingMobility.wasAirborne===true};
 c.trait=TRAIT_IDS.includes(current.trait)?current.trait:null;

 c.traitFreeChangeUsed=current.traitFreeChangeUsed===true;
 c.statFreeResetUsed=current.statFreeResetUsed===true;
 c.claimedMilestones=Array.isArray(current.claimedMilestones)?[...new Set(current.claimedMilestones.filter(id=>CHARACTER_MILESTONES.some(m=>m.id===id)))]:[];
 let bits=decodeXpClaims(current.xpClaimedCellsB64);
 markOldRemovedCells(bits,edits); // prevents migration from granting historic removed cells.
 xpClaimBits=bits;
 c.xpClaimedCellsB64=encodeXpClaims(bits);
 if(legacy)c.legacyDepthNeedsBaseline=true; // avoid retroactive depth awards to existing players.
 return c;
}
function prepareCharacterForSave(){if(game?.character){
 game.character.xpClaimedCellsB64=encodeXpClaims();
 // A queued save can occur while midair or while clinging to the rope.
 game.character.mobility={ropeLeapRemaining:remainingRopeLeaps(),wasAirborne:!!(p&&(rope.active||(!collides(p.x,p.y+.055))))};
 }}
function awardCharacterXp(amount,label=''){if(!Number.isSafeInteger(amount)||amount<=0)return 0;const before=deriveLevelFromTotalXp(game.character.totalXp).level;game.character.totalXp=Math.min(MAX_CHARACTER_XP,game.character.totalXp+amount);const after=deriveLevelFromTotalXp(game.character.totalXp).level;if(after>before){flash(`광부 Lv.${after}! 능력치 ${after-before}SP 획득`);}return after-before;}
function blockExperience(t){if(t==='relic')return 8;if(t==='orecoal'||t==='copper')return 3;if(t==='iron')return 5;if(t==='titanium')return 7;if(t==='starshard')return 11;if(['crystal','amber','opal'].includes(t))return 8;if(['grass','dirt','sand','snow','stone','wood','wall','glass'].includes(t))return 1;return 0;}
function blockXpEligible(x,y,t){const xp=blockExperience(t);if(!xp||xpCellClaimed(x,y))return false;const loc=key(x,y);if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(game.edits,loc))return false;return terrainType(x,y)===t;}
function grantBlockXpIfEligible(x,y,t,eligible){if(!eligible||!claimXpCell(x,y))return false;awardCharacterXp(blockExperience(t),t);return true;}
function baselineLegacyDepth(){if(!game.character.legacyDepthNeedsBaseline)return;const depth=Math.max(0,Math.floor(p.y-terrain(p.x)));for(const m of CHARACTER_MILESTONES)if(depth>=m.depth&&!game.character.claimedMilestones.includes(m.id))game.character.claimedMilestones.push(m.id);delete game.character.legacyDepthNeedsBaseline;}
function claimMilestoneXp(){if(!p||!game?.character)return;baselineLegacyDepth();const depth=Math.max(0,Math.floor(p.y-terrain(p.x)));for(const m of CHARACTER_MILESTONES){if(depth>=m.depth&&!game.character.claimedMilestones.includes(m.id)){game.character.claimedMilestones.push(m.id);const earned=m.xp+(game.character.trait==='pioneer'?Math.floor(m.xp*.10):0);awardCharacterXp(earned,m.id);flash(`${m.depth}m 깊이 도달 · +${earned} EXP`);}}}
function safeCharacterTransaction(change){const old=game,oldBits=xpClaimBits;try{const draft=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(old));if(change(draft)!==true)return false;game=draft;if(!saveGame(true)){game=old;xpClaimBits=oldBits;updHud();flash('저장 실패: 능력치 변경이 취소됐어요.');return false;}updHud();return true;}catch(_){game=old;xpClaimBits=oldBits;updHud();flash('능력치 처리 오류로 변경을 취소했어요.');return false;}}
function allocateStatPoint(id){if(!CHARACTER_STAT_IDS.includes(id))return false;
 const ok=safeCharacterTransaction(draft=>{const stats=draft.character.stats;if(getUnspentSp(draft.character)<1||stats[id]>=8)return false;stats[id]++;return true;});
 if(ok){clampRopeLeaps();updateMobilityHud();}return ok;}

function resetStatPoints(){const spent=CHARACTER_STAT_IDS.reduce((n,k)=>n+game.character.stats[k],0);if(spent===0)return false;
 const ok=safeCharacterTransaction(draft=>{const c=draft.character;if(c.statFreeResetUsed){if(draft.coins<250)return false;draft.coins-=250;}else c.statFreeResetUsed=true;for(const id of CHARACTER_STAT_IDS)c.stats[id]=0;return true;});
 if(ok){clampRopeLeaps();updateMobilityHud();}return ok;}

let characterTab='stats';
function refreshCharacterMenu(tab=characterTab){const scroll=$('dialog').scrollTop;characterTab=tab;characterMenu();$('dialog').scrollTop=scroll;}
function characterMenu(){
 const character=game.character,progress=deriveLevelFromTotalXp(character.totalXp),points=getUnspentSp(character);
 const ratio=progress.requiredNext?Math.min(100,Math.round(100*progress.earnedThisLevel/progress.requiredNext)):100;
 const ability=mobilityDerived();
 const labels={agility:`이동 ${ability.moveSpeed.toFixed(2)}칸/초`,jump:`일반 점프 ${ability.jumpImpulse.toFixed(2)} · 로프 도약 ${ability.ropeLeapImpulse.toFixed(2)}`,climb:`로프 ${ability.ropeClimbSpeed.toFixed(2)}칸/초`,observation:`지하 시야 ${effectiveSightRadius()}칸`,focus:`채굴속도 +${Math.round((ability.mineMultiplier-1)*1000)/10}%`,endurance:`로프 도약 ${ability.ropeLeapMax}회 · 재연결 ${ability.ropeCooldown.toFixed(2)}초`,reach:`채굴 반경 ${effectiveMineReach().toFixed(2)}칸`};
 let content='';
 if(characterTab==='stats'){
  const rows=CHARACTER_STAT_IDS.map(id=>`<div class="line char-stat"><div><strong>${CHARACTER_STAT_NAMES[id]}</strong><br><small>${labels[id]}</small></div><div class="char-stat-action"><b>${character.stats[id]}/8</b><button data-char-stat="${id}" aria-label="${CHARACTER_STAT_NAMES[id]} 능력치 1 증가" ${points===0||character.stats[id]>=8?'disabled':''}>+1</button></div></div>`).join('');
  content=`<h3 class="char-subtitle">능력치 · ${points} SP 남음</h3>${rows}<div class="line"><div><strong>포인트 초기화</strong><br><small>${character.statFreeResetUsed?'250 크레딧':'첫 1회 무료'}</small></div><button id="resetCharacterStats" ${CHARACTER_STAT_IDS.every(k=>!character.stats[k])?'disabled':''}>초기화</button></div>`;
 }else if(characterTab==='traits'){
  content=`<p class="char-intro">한 가지 개성을 선택하세요. 장비를 바꿔도 효과가 유지돼요.</p><div class="char-choice-list">${TRAIT_IDS.map(id=>{const t=TRAIT_INFO[id],chosen=character.trait===id,change=!!character.trait;const locked=change&&progress.level<10,cost=change?(character.traitFreeChangeUsed?200:0):0;return `<div class="char-choice${chosen?' chosen':''}"><span class="char-emblem">${t.icon}</span><div class="char-choice-body"><strong>${t.name}</strong><small>${t.tag}</small></div><button data-trait="${id}" ${chosen||locked||game.coins<cost?'disabled':''}>${chosen?'선택됨':locked?'Lv.10':cost?cost+'C':'선택'}</button></div>`;}).join('')}</div><p class="char-note">첫 선택 무료 · Lv.10부터 교체 · 첫 교체 무료, 이후 200C</p>`;
 }else{
  const sys=game.artifactSystem,slots=artifactSlotsFor(progress.level);
  const slotRows=Array.from({length:2},(_,i)=>{const id=sys.equippedIds[i],item=id?ARTIFACT_INFO[id]:null,locked=i>=slots;return `<div class="char-slot"><span class="char-emblem">${locked?'🔒':item?item.icon:'＋'}</span><div class="char-choice-body"><strong>유물 슬롯 ${i+1}</strong><small>${locked?'Lv.12에 해금':item?item.name+' · '+item.tag:'장착된 유물 없음'}</small></div>${item?`<button data-unequip="${i}">해제</button>`:''}</div>`;}).join('');
  const cards=ARTIFACT_IDS.map(id=>{const item=ARTIFACT_INFO[id],owned=sys.ownedIds.includes(id),slot=sys.equippedIds.indexOf(id),freeSlot=Array.from({length:slots},(_,i)=>i).find(i=>!sys.equippedIds[i]);return `<div class="char-choice${slot>=0?' chosen':''}"><span class="char-emblem">${owned?item.icon:'?'}</span><div class="char-choice-body"><strong>${owned?item.name:'미발견 유물'}</strong><small>${owned?item.tag:'획득 조건 · '+item.how}</small></div>${owned?`<button data-artifact="${id}" ${slot>=0||freeSlot===undefined?'disabled':''}>${slot>=0?'장착 중':freeSlot===undefined?'슬롯 꽉 참':'장착'}</button>`:''}</div>`;}).join('');
  content=`<h3 class="char-subtitle">유물 장착 <small>${sys.ownedIds.length}/6 발견</small></h3><div class="char-slot-grid">${slotRows}</div><h3 class="char-subtitle">수집한 유물</h3><div class="char-choice-list">${cards}</div><p class="char-note">상태 변경은 저장 성공 시 확정돼요. 기존 유물 채굴 기록 ${game.relics}회는 그대로 보존돼요.</p>`;
 }
 const tabs=[['stats','능력치'],['traits','개성'],['artifacts','유물']].map(([id,label])=>`<button class="${characterTab===id?'active':''}" role="tab" aria-selected="${characterTab===id}" data-char-tab="${id}">${label}</button>`).join('');
 showModal('광부 성장',`<div class="char-head"><div><span>광부 레벨</span><strong>Lv.${progress.level}</strong></div><div><span>미사용</span><strong>${points} SP</strong></div></div><div class="char-progress" role="progressbar" aria-valuenow="${ratio}" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-label="다음 광부 레벨 경험치"><div style="width:${ratio}%"></div></div><p class="char-note">${progress.requiredNext?`${progress.earnedThisLevel} / ${progress.requiredNext} EXP`:'Lv.30 최고 레벨'} · 총 ${character.totalXp} EXP · 발견한 지하 공동 ${game.cavernDiscoveries?.length||0}곳</p><nav class="char-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="광부 성장 메뉴">${tabs}</nav>${content}`);
 $('dialog').classList.add('ss-ui-modal','ss-growth-modal');$('backBtn').textContent='닫기';
 for(const b of $('dialog').querySelectorAll('[data-char-tab]'))b.onclick=()=>{characterTab=b.dataset.charTab;refreshCharacterMenu();$('dialog').scrollTop=0;};

 if($('resetCharacterStats'))$('resetCharacterStats').onclick=()=>{if(resetStatPoints())refreshCharacterMenu();else flash('초기화할 능력치가 없거나 크레딧이 부족해요.');};
 for(const b of $('dialog').querySelectorAll('[data-trait]'))b.onclick=()=>{if(selectCharacterTrait(b.dataset.trait))refreshCharacterMenu();else flash('개성을 바꿀 수 없어요. 레벨과 크레딧을 확인하세요.');};
 for(const b of $('dialog').querySelectorAll('[data-artifact]'))b.onclick=()=>{const empty=Array.from({length:artifactSlotsFor()},(_,i)=>i).find(i=>!game.artifactSystem.equippedIds[i]);if(empty!==undefined&&equipArtifact(empty,b.dataset.artifact))refreshCharacterMenu();else flash('장착 슬롯이나 유물 획득 상태를 확인하세요.');};
 for(const b of $('dialog').querySelectorAll('[data-unequip]'))b.onclick=()=>{if(equipArtifact(Number(b.dataset.unequip),null))refreshCharacterMenu();else flash('유물 해제가 취소됐어요.');};
}

function normalizeShelterState(raw){
  const t=raw&&typeof raw==='object'&&!Array.isArray(raw)?raw:{};
  const validDate=typeof t.lastRestAt==='string'&&/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T/.test(t.lastRestAt)&&!Number.isNaN(Date.parse(t.lastRestAt));
  return {restCount:Number.isSafeInteger(t.restCount)&&t.restCount>=0?Math.min(1000000,t.restCount):0,
    lastRestAt:validDate?new Date(t.lastRestAt).toISOString():null,
    lastRestX:Number.isFinite(t.lastRestX)&&t.lastRestX>=0&&t.lastRestX<=WW?t.lastRestX:null,
    lastRestY:Number.isFinite(t.lastRestY)&&t.lastRestY>=0&&t.lastRestY<=WH?t.lastRestY:null};
}
// M1 dedicated world region, deliberately separate from production key and mine edits.
const TOWN_WORLD_ID='village_hub_01', TOWN_MINE_PORTAL_X=40;
let ssRegion=TOWN_WORLD_ID;
const M1_MINE_CRYSTAL_X=55,M1_MINE_GATE_X=64,M1_FOREST_GATE_X=22,M1_FOREST_SPRING_X=120;
function ssM1Fresh(){return {schema:1,region:TOWN_WORLD_ID,minePos:null,forestPos:null,townPos:null,forestEdits:{},crystalSeen:false,forestVisited:false,springRepaired:false,storyRewarded:false,storyEvents:[]}}
function ssM1Normalize(raw){
 const d=ssM1Fresh();if(!raw||typeof raw!=='object'||Array.isArray(raw))return d;
 d.region=[TOWN_WORLD_ID,'mine','life_forest_01'].includes(raw.region)?raw.region:'mine';
 for(const k of ['minePos','forestPos','townPos'])if(raw[k]&&typeof raw[k]==='object'&&Number.isFinite(raw[k].x)&&Number.isFinite(raw[k].y)&&raw[k].x>12&&raw[k].x<145&&raw[k].y>0&&raw[k].y<WH-5)d[k]={x:raw[k].x,y:raw[k].y};
 if(raw.forestEdits&&typeof raw.forestEdits==='object'&&!Array.isArray(raw.forestEdits)){for(const [key,v] of Object.entries(raw.forestEdits).slice(0,16000)){if(/^\d{1,3},\d{1,3}$/.test(key)&&(v===null||SOLIDS.has(v)))d.forestEdits[key]=v;}}
 for(const k of ['crystalSeen','forestVisited','springRepaired','storyRewarded'])d[k]=raw[k]===true;
 if(Array.isArray(raw.storyEvents))d.storyEvents=raw.storyEvents.filter(x=>typeof x==='string'&&x.length<100).slice(-25);
 return d;
}
function newGame(seed=(Math.random()*1000000000)|0){return {storyM1:ssM1Fresh(),livingP0:freshLivingP0(),cargoTrial:ssCargoFresh(),shelter:{restCount:0,lastRestAt:null,lastRestX:null,lastRestY:null},seed:Math.abs(seed),edits:{},inv:{dirt:0,stone:0,wood:0,wall:0,glass:0,torch:0,bed:0,chest:0,copper:0,iron:0,crystal:0,titanium:0,starshard:0,orecoal:0,amber:0,opal:0},coins:50,mined:0,pickaxeLevel:1,drillMotor:{rank:1},drillBits:{owned:['tunnel'],equipped:'tunnel'},hammerCore:{rank:1},ropeDevice:{rank:1},pickaxeForge:{rank:0,failStreak:0,attemptCounter:0,affinity:'none',affinitySwitches:0,bonusOreDrops:0,secondary:'none',secondarySwitches:0},tool:'pickaxe',unlockedTools:['pickaxe'],oreFinds:0,relics:0,character:freshCharacter(),artifactSystem:freshArtifactSystem(),vision:freshVision(),worldGenVersion:5,cavernDiscoveries:[],treasureP13:ssTreasureFresh(),resourceLayerVersion:1,spawnX:SPAWN_X,spawnY:null,plotOwned:false,storage:{},economy:{reserveLiftMaterials:true,reserveForgeMaterials:true,totalOreSold:0,totalCreditsEarned:0,balanceMetrics:freshBalanceMetrics()},walked:0,transport:{discovered:['surface'],unlocked:['surface'],lastSafeId:'surface'},createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),playerX:null,playerY:null,version:1}}
function normalizeSave(d){if(!d||!Number.isFinite(d.seed)||!d.inv||typeof d.inv!=='object'||!d.edits||typeof d.edits!=='object')throw Error('bad save');d.shelter=normalizeShelterState(d.shelter);if(!Number.isFinite(d.worldGenVersion))d.worldGenVersion=1; // 2.18-H3: deterministic new ores only on unedited rock/ore tiles; old edits remain authoritative.
 d.cavernDiscoveries=Array.isArray(d.cavernDiscoveries)?[...new Set(d.cavernDiscoveries.filter(id=>typeof id==='string'&&/^cv:(?:[0-9]|[1-9][0-9]*):(?:[0-9]|[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(id)&&id.length<=24))].slice(0,320):[];d.resourceLayerVersion=1;d.treasureP13=ssTreasureNormalize(d.treasureP13);d.drillMotor=p16NormalizeDrillMotor(d.drillMotor);d.drillBits=p16a2NormalizeBits(d.drillBits);d.hammerCore=p16HammerNormalizeCore(d.hammerCore);d.ropeDevice=p16RopeNormalize(d.ropeDevice); if(!Number.isFinite(d.pickaxeLevel))d.pickaxeLevel=1;if(!Number.isFinite(d.oreFinds))d.oreFinds=0;if(!Number.isFinite(d.relics))d.relics=0;if(!Array.isArray(d.unlockedTools))d.unlockedTools=['pickaxe'];d.unlockedTools=[...new Set(['pickaxe',...d.unlockedTools.filter(t=>Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(TOOL_INFO,t))])];if(!TOOL_INFO[d.tool]||!d.unlockedTools.includes(d.tool))d.tool='pickaxe';if(!d.storage||typeof d.storage!=='object')d.storage={};const ec=d.economy&&typeof d.economy==='object'&&!Array.isArray(d.economy)?d.economy:{};d.economy={reserveLiftMaterials:ec.reserveLiftMaterials!==false,reserveForgeMaterials:ec.reserveForgeMaterials!==false,totalOreSold:Number.isSafeInteger(ec.totalOreSold)&&ec.totalOreSold>=0?ec.totalOreSold:0,totalCreditsEarned:Number.isSafeInteger(ec.totalCreditsEarned)&&ec.totalCreditsEarned>=0?ec.totalCreditsEarned:0,balanceMetrics:normalizeBalanceMetrics(ec.balanceMetrics)};
 const tr=d.transport&&typeof d.transport==='object'?d.transport:{};const valid=xs=>Array.isArray(xs)?xs.filter(id=>STATION_DATA.some(st=>st.id===id)):[];
 d.transport={discovered:[...new Set(['surface',...valid(tr.discovered)])],unlocked:[...new Set(['surface',...valid(tr.unlocked)])],lastSafeId:valid(tr.unlocked).includes(tr.lastSafeId)?tr.lastSafeId:'surface'};
 for(const item of Object.keys(MATERIAL_NAMES)){if(!Number.isFinite(d.inv[item])||d.inv[item]<0)d.inv[item]=0}d.pickaxeForge=normalizePickaxeForge(d.pickaxeForge);d.character=normalizeCharacter(d.character,d.edits);d.artifactSystem=normalizeArtifactSystem(d.artifactSystem,deriveLevelFromTotalXp(d.character.totalXp).level);
  // Validate restored charges only AFTER checking the equipped, owned knot ring.
  // Otherwise airborne saves with three charges silently lose one on reload.
  const allowedLeaps=Math.min(3,1+(d.character.stats.endurance>=5?1:0)+(d.artifactSystem.equippedIds.includes('knot_ring')?1:0));
  d.character.mobility.ropeLeapRemaining=Math.min(allowedLeaps,d.character.mobility.ropeLeapRemaining);
  d.cargoTrial=ssCargoNormalize(d.cargoTrial);d.vision=normalizeVision(d.vision);d.livingP0=normalizeLivingP0(d.livingP0);d.storyM1=ssM1Normalize(d.storyM1);return d}
// SANDSTAR LIVING P1.1: deterministic local commands, save-schema 2, multiplayer-ready domain boundary.
// Single-player only; never write production storage. Terrain, rope, mining and cargo remain owned by v10.1.
const LIVING_SITES=Object.freeze({trees:[82,94,106],plots:[34,37,40],pond:64,market:23,home:53});
const LIVING_CROPS=Object.freeze({wheat:{name:'밀',seconds:75,seed:'seed_wheat',price:8},potato:{name:'감자',seconds:105,seed:'seed_potato',price:11},carrot:{name:'당근',seconds:90,seed:'seed_carrot',price:10}});
const LIVING_FISH=Object.freeze({river_fish:{name:'은빛 피라미',price:8,pull:16},perch:{name:'강농어',price:12,pull:21},carp:{name:'비단잉어',price:17,pull:27}});
const LIVING_RECIPES=Object.freeze({bread:{name:'갓 구운 빵',price:16,needs:{wheat:3},wood:1,buff:'harvest'},soup:{name:'당근 수프',price:18,needs:{carrot:2,potato:1},wood:1,buff:'wood'},stew:{name:'생선 스튜',price:21,needs:{river_fish:1,potato:1},wood:1,buff:'fish'}});
const LIVING_NPCS=Object.freeze({carpenter:{name:'목수',x:23,cooldown:180,payout:26},farmer:{name:'농부',x:34,cooldown:180,payout:24},fisher:{name:'어부',x:64,cooldown:180,payout:25}});
const LIVING_CLOCK_TREE=120,LIVING_CLOCK_FISH=12;
const livingOwn=(o,k)=>Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(o,k);
const livingInt=(n,max=1000000)=>Number.isSafeInteger(n)&&n>=0?Math.min(n,max):0;
function freshLivingP0(){
 const trees={},plots={},npcs={};
 for(const x of LIVING_SITES.trees)trees[`tree:${x}`]=0;
 for(const x of LIVING_SITES.plots)plots[`plot:${x}`]={plantedAt:null,watered:false,crop:null};
 for(const id of Object.keys(LIVING_NPCS))npcs[id]={completed:0,readyAt:0};
 return {schema:2,revision:0,clock:0,trees,plots,pondReadyAt:0,houseBuilt:false,rod:false,fishing:null,
   bag:{seed:6,crop:0,seed_wheat:3,seed_potato:3,seed_carrot:3,sapling:0,wheat:0,potato:0,carrot:0,river_fish:0,perch:0,carp:0,bread:0,soup:0,stew:0},
   stats:{cut:0,planted:0,harvested:0,fished:0,sold:0,cooked:0,quests:0},npcs,
   fishDex:[],foodBuff:null,appliedIds:[],events:[]};
}
function normalizeLivingP0(raw){
 const state=freshLivingP0(); if(!raw||typeof raw!=='object'||Array.isArray(raw))return state;
 state.clock=Number.isFinite(raw.clock)&&raw.clock>=0?Math.min(raw.clock,1e9):0;
 state.revision=livingInt(raw.revision);
 if(raw.trees&&typeof raw.trees==='object')for(const id of Object.keys(state.trees))if(Number.isFinite(raw.trees[id])&&raw.trees[id]>=0)state.trees[id]=Math.min(raw.trees[id],1e9);
 if(raw.plots&&typeof raw.plots==='object')for(const id of Object.keys(state.plots)){
  const v=raw.plots[id];if(!v||typeof v!=='object')continue;
  const plantedAt=Number.isFinite(v.plantedAt)&&v.plantedAt>=0?Math.min(v.plantedAt,state.clock):null;
  const crop=plantedAt===null?null:(livingOwn(LIVING_CROPS,v.crop)?v.crop:'legacy');
  state.plots[id]={plantedAt,watered:v.watered===true,crop};
 }
 state.pondReadyAt=Number.isFinite(raw.pondReadyAt)&&raw.pondReadyAt>=0?Math.min(raw.pondReadyAt,1e9):0;
 state.houseBuilt=raw.houseBuilt===true;state.rod=raw.rod===true;
 if(raw.bag&&typeof raw.bag==='object')for(const id of Object.keys(state.bag)){
  if(livingOwn(raw.bag,id))state.bag[id]=livingInt(raw.bag[id]);
  else if(raw.schema===2)state.bag[id]=0; // migration-only starter seeds, no free P1.1 inventory refill
 }
 if(raw.stats&&typeof raw.stats==='object')for(const id of Object.keys(state.stats))state.stats[id]=livingInt(raw.stats[id]);
 if(raw.npcs&&typeof raw.npcs==='object')for(const id of Object.keys(state.npcs)){
  const q=raw.npcs[id];if(!q||typeof q!=='object')continue;
  state.npcs[id]={completed:livingInt(q.completed),readyAt:Number.isFinite(q.readyAt)&&q.readyAt>=0?Math.min(q.readyAt,1e9):0};
 }
 if(raw.fishing&&typeof raw.fishing==='object'&&livingOwn(LIVING_FISH,raw.fishing.id)){
  const f=raw.fishing;state.fishing={id:f.id,progress:Math.min(100,livingInt(f.progress)),tension:Math.min(100,livingInt(f.tension)),round:Math.min(30,livingInt(f.round))};
 }
 if(Array.isArray(raw.fishDex))state.fishDex=[...new Set(raw.fishDex.filter(id=>livingOwn(LIVING_FISH,id)))];
 if(raw.foodBuff&&typeof raw.foodBuff==='object'&&['harvest','wood','fish'].includes(raw.foodBuff.type)&&Number.isFinite(raw.foodBuff.until)&&raw.foodBuff.until>state.clock){state.foodBuff={type:raw.foodBuff.type,until:Math.min(raw.foodBuff.until,1e9)};}
 if(Array.isArray(raw.appliedIds))state.appliedIds=raw.appliedIds.filter(id=>typeof id==='string'&&id.length>0&&id.length<100).slice(-64);
 if(Array.isArray(raw.events))state.events=raw.events.filter(e=>e&&typeof e==='object'&&typeof e.kind==='string'&&typeof e.id==='string').slice(-14).map(e=>({id:e.id,kind:e.kind,at:livingInt(e.at),actor:'local'}));
 return state;
}
function livingTargetX(target){
 if(typeof target!=='string')return null;
 if(target==='pond')return 64;if(target==='market'||target==='kitchen'||target==='npc:carpenter')return 23;
 if(target==='home')return 53;if(target==='npc:farmer')return 34;if(target==='npc:fisher')return 64;
 if(/^tree:(82|94|106)$/.test(target)||/^plot:(34|37|40)$/.test(target))return Number(target.split(':')[1]);
 return null;
}
function applyLivingCommandPure(prev,cmd,context){
 const bad=reason=>({ok:false,reason});
 if(!cmd||typeof cmd!=='object'||typeof cmd.id!=='string'||cmd.id.length<1||cmd.id.length>96)return bad('잘못된 명령이에요');
 if(!context||!Number.isFinite(context.coins)||context.coins<0||!Number.isFinite(context.x)||!Number.isFinite(context.y)||!Number.isFinite(context.groundY))return bad('플레이어 상태가 잘못되었어요');
 const state=normalizeLivingP0(prev),inv={...(context.inv||{})};
 if(state.appliedIds.includes(cmd.id))return bad('이미 처리한 행동이에요');
 if(typeof cmd.type!=='string'||typeof cmd.target!=='string')return bad('행동 종류를 확인해 주세요');
 const anywhereFood=cmd.type==='food.eat'&&cmd.target==='self';
 if(!anywhereFood&&Math.abs(context.y-context.groundY)>5)return bad('지상에서 이용해 주세요');
 const tx=anywhereFood?context.x:livingTargetX(cmd.target);if(tx===null||Math.abs(context.x-tx)>5.2)return bad('이용 장소에 더 가까이 가야 해요');
 const stock=id=>livingInt(inv[id]),bag=id=>livingInt(state.bag[id]);
 const hasBuff=type=>state.foodBuff?.type===type&&state.foodBuff.until>state.clock;
 let award=0,message='',kind=cmd.type;
 switch(kind){
  case 'tree.cut':{
   if(!livingOwn(state.trees,cmd.target))return bad('이 나무는 벌목할 수 없어요');
   if(state.trees[cmd.target]>state.clock)return bad('나무가 다시 자라는 중이에요');
   state.trees[cmd.target]=state.clock+LIVING_CLOCK_TREE;
   const quantity=3+(hasBuff('wood')?1:0);inv.wood=stock('wood')+quantity;
   state.stats.cut++;if(state.stats.cut%2===0)state.bag.sapling++;
   message=`원목 ${quantity}개 획득 · 묘목 재생 시작`;break;}
  case 'tree.plant':{
   if(!livingOwn(state.trees,cmd.target))return bad('나무를 심을 장소가 아니에요');
   if(state.trees[cmd.target]<=state.clock)return bad('이미 나무가 자라고 있어요');
   if(bag('sapling')<1)return bad('묘목이 부족해요');
   if(state.trees[cmd.target]<=state.clock+25)return bad('이미 거의 다 자랐어요');
   state.bag.sapling--;state.trees[cmd.target]=state.clock+25;message='묘목을 심어 재성장을 앞당겼어요';break;}
  case 'plot.plant':{
   const plot=state.plots[cmd.target];if(!plot)return bad('등록된 농지가 아니에요');
   if(plot.plantedAt!==null)return bad('이미 작물이 있어요');
   const type=livingOwn(LIVING_CROPS,cmd.item)?cmd.item:(cmd.item===undefined||cmd.item==='legacy'?'legacy':null);
   if(!type)return bad('등록되지 않은 씨앗이에요');
   const seed=type==='legacy'?'seed':LIVING_CROPS[type].seed;
   if(bag(seed)<1)return bad('씨앗이 부족해요');
   state.bag[seed]--;plot.plantedAt=state.clock;plot.watered=false;plot.crop=type;
   state.stats.planted++;message=(type==='legacy'?'채소':LIVING_CROPS[type].name)+' 씨앗을 심었어요';break;}
